closureReview.note: The five native tenant/listener tests and related FS-RULES receipts are not cross-product closure evidence on this branch.

scopeDecisions.recommendation: Reuse FS-RULES receipts only for identical principal, claim, tenant and token-state inputs after source integration and binding; require new observations for transaction, listener and SDK cross-product effects.
Keep end-user transaction authorization outcomes here while FS-TRANSACTION owns generic conflict and retry semantics; explicitly decide whether any refusal is a production dependency boundary.
Require declared firebase 12.18.0 Web SDK in Node and a real browser, plus native REST/gRPC. Exclude Android and Apple because the declared SDK matrix does not include them.
Use fireemu-oracle-idp/(default) only with FS-RULES ownership of the Rules release and tenant changes, and read back their restoration. Do not run while its shared lock is held.
Freeze a finite revocation/deletion listener observation window and commit-triggered control; a quiet timeout alone does not prove an absence of events.
Decide any observed cross-product divergence only after two receipts and final-artifact comparison; no predicted listener outcome is preapproved.

Keep token minting and refresh protocol in AUTH-CREDENTIAL, generic Rules language in FS-RULES, generic Listen/reconnect in FS-LISTEN-SDK, tenant administration in AUTH-TENANT-BLOCKING and generic transaction conflict/retry in FS-TRANSACTION.

productionPlan.requestRangeBasis: A separate FS-RULES expiry re-record used 1038 requests for two passes, and the complete local browser Listen catalog used 2776 WebChannel requests across two modes and two recordings. The cross-product subset, Node SDK, Auth changes, setup and cleanup differ; this is a conservative planning range, not a send cap.
productionPlan.cleanup: Close listeners and clients; conditionally delete and read back owned documents and test accounts; restore and read back the FS-RULES Rules release, tenant state and any temporary identity permissions.
prerequisites: FS-RULES source and closure evidence integrated or explicitly referenced without promotion
FS-RULES owner schedules exclusive idp Firestore and Rules access; no shared lock overlap
New finite cross-product corpus, source-bound runner, all-wire accounting and recovery packet
Two sandbox recordings, clean-context review, owner decision, run ledger and final comparison
productionPlan.costEstimateBasis: At 8000 requests charged at a conservative US$0.0001 each, request cost is US$0.80; US$5 is a provisional planning ceiling with margin for network and ancillary operations. A source-bound packet must price the actual operation mix and remain within the standing US$10 task budget.
